name: Hotaru
source: The heroine of the Heian period. The daughter of Miyatsuko Maro, a wealthy man residing in Kitakatano. A young woman possessing both intelligence and beauty renowned throughout the capital. Her encounter with Takahisa would drastically alter the course of both their destinies.
